sessions.title: Anger Management & De-escalation
sessions.subtitle: Mastering Emotional Control in High-Pressure Situations
sessions.description: A structured classroom session designed to help participants recognize emotional triggers, practice breathing techniques, and apply de-escalation strategies.

steps.title: Opening Motivational Video: Breaking the Impulse Cycle
steps.content: A short visual presentation illustrating how emotional responses form and how a 5-second pause can prevent lifetime consequences.

steps.title: Real-Life Story: Vikram's Turning Point
steps.content: The journey of a former inmate who mastered emotional discipline after 8 years in prison and built a community youth center.

steps.title: Group Discussion: Recognizing Your Emotional Triggers
steps.content: Guided discussion led by instructor on identifying internal warning signs before anger escalates.
questions: What physical signs tell you that anger is taking over?
What would you have done differently in a recent conflict?
How does remaining calm protect your future?

steps.title: Emotional Learning Activity: The 5-4-3-2-1 Calm Routine
steps.content: Interactive breathing and sensory grounding exercise performed together by all participants.

steps.title: Personal Reflection & Journaling
steps.content: Participants write down one commitment for the week on how to handle frustration constructively.

steps.title: Closing Message: Building Self-Respect Daily
steps.content: Summary by Priya Rajan emphasizing that self-control is the ultimate sign of strength.

stories.title: The Second Chance of Marcus Vance
stories.summary: After serving 12 years, Marcus committed to learning computer programming and now mentors underprivileged youth.
stories.fullText: Marcus Vance spent over a decade reflecting on a single impulsive night that altered his life trajectory...
stories.moral: Your past explains where you have been, but it never defines where you can go.

books.title: Man's Search for Meaning
books.author: Viktor E. Frankl
books.description: Psychiatrist Viktor Frankl's memoir of suffering in concentration camps and finding purpose.
books.summaryText: Even in conditions of severe restriction, human beings retain the ultimate freedom: to choose one's attitude.

caseWorkerNotes: Demonstrates high engagement during group discussions.
Completed Victor Frankl reading assignment with thoughtful written reflection.
